description: A single TreeSupport.cpp production mutation for the explicit first-support-footprint brim-width oracle. This validates the new test oracle; existing tree-brim cases may also detect the same forced-zero behavior, so it is not claimed as unique detection of a pre-existing gap.

mutants.description: Force the configured tree brim width to zero; the exact new case must lose the asserted first-support-footprint area increase under a 16 mm explicit brim.
mutants.test_filter: Tree support brim width changes the first support footprint
